scope: Bounded independent arithmetic and explicit source prerequisites only; no full historical certificate replay.

checked.label: First odd scalar frontier
checked.result: 41 triples; 40 scalar exclusions; a cyclic mask at (5, 7, 23).

checked.label: Canonical length ten
checked.result: 26 profiles and 208 assignments; successive survivor counts are 37 after determinant tests, 21 after rank bounds, 1 after forbidden patterns, and 0 after skew tests.
checked.limit: Assumes the inherited source-rank and categorical determinant hypotheses.

checked.label: Two degree-two blocks at rank fourteen
checked.result: 32 placements; 5 determinant survivors and no forbidden-pattern survivors.
checked.limit: Only the two-block subcase used in this theorem. The other rank-fourteen algebra shape is not checked.

checked.label: Dyadic compression
checked.result: All 8 gamma values and 7 nonidentity theta values.
checked.limit: Checks the modulus-eight calculation, not the general-level representation-theoretic reduction.

checked.label: Explicit thirteen-row obstruction
checked.limit: The specified assignment only. Global uniqueness is not checked.

checked.label: Four coefficient control pools
checked.result: Pools of 145, 340, 369 and 99 raw rows; bounded coefficients checked.
checked.limit: Pool completeness and global exclusion are not established.

checked.label: Certificate monotonicity regression
checked.result: Linear, bounded and modular certificates valid on a smaller row set are rejected when invalidated by an added row.
checked.limit: Synthetic controls only; no global row-domain coverage is established.

checked.label: Orthogonal codegree-six support catalogue
checked.result: 1,344 integral states; 528 positive states; 23 integral signed signatures and 16 positive signed signatures.
checked.limit: The reduction from 16 positive signed signatures to 14 uses the manuscript's separate Perron argument, not this computation.

checked.label: Cubic degree-four E3 branch
checked.result: Both descriptions excluded by an independently checked exact scalar system.
checked.limit: Only this finite branch under the stated mathematical hypotheses.

checked.label: Cubic degree-four E4 branch
checked.result: 2 A types and 21 B types; 20 direct scalar-cone exclusions and 1 proper-generator-core exclusion for the B types.
checked.limit: Only this finite branch under the stated mathematical hypotheses.

checked.label: Symplectic profiles on at most seven slots
checked.result: All profile counts for norms 1 through 15, 18, 25 and 27; 379,409 minor-chart extensions and 746,779 nonunit coefficient arrays independently tested.
checked.limit: Only these norms and at most seven slots; not an unrestricted profile catalogue.
